name: @w6w-apps/ringcentral
description: Send SMS, read the message store and call log, look up extensions and the company directory, and place RingOut calls over the RingCentral Platform API.

w6w.longDescription:
RingCentral runs phone, SMS and team communication for a business, and this app covers the core a workflow reaches for: send an SMS from a Toll-Free number, read the message store, and look up an account's extensions, phone numbers and company directory. Pull call log records, including the detailed per-leg view, check whether a colleague is available before reaching out, and place a RingOut call that rings two numbers and bridges them together.

Every action can act on the connection's own extension by default or, for an admin credential, target a specific extension elsewhere in the account — useful for pulling another user's call log or presence without needing their own connection.

This app targets RingCentral's core communication and directory data rather than call control, provisioning, meetings or video: day-to-day lookups and messaging a workflow can act on immediately, not account administration.
